representativeSnapshot.kind: isolated Supabase target with org, venue, and artist rows carrying legacy plaintext token columns, plus a venue vault row at key_version 0

rowCountQueries: Count rows with non-null access_token or refresh_token on public.organization_social_integrations and public.venue_social_integrations
Count key_version = 0 rows with non-null secret bytes on public.venue_social_integration_secrets
Record column-level privileges (has_column_privilege) for anon and authenticated on the organization_social_integrations token columns
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: One UPDATE per existing plaintext row on organization_social_integrations and venue_social_integrations, plus one UPDATE per key_version=0 venue vault row; zero new objects are created

execution.resumeStrategy: Apply to isolated staging first under CP-051; a partial or failed apply is corrected with a later additive forward fix, never a replay or reset
execution.idempotency: REVOKE and scoped UPDATE statements are deterministic and repeatable; no object creation requires IF NOT EXISTS

quarantine.strategy: No new table; legacy plaintext columns remain nullable for server-only service_role readers until the Edge Function consumers move to the vault boundary

constraints: No constraints are added or changed; token columns keep their existing nullability
indexes: No indexes change; existing integration PK/FK and org/venue indexes are untouched
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: After apply, run the inline probes from the migration: plaintext column counts are zero, has_column_privilege(authenticated, access_token) is false for organization_social_integrations, and key_version=0 vault secret bytes are null; re-run the focused INTG-007 vitest suite

recovery.rollback: No objects are dropped, so rollback means accepting revocation: legacy plaintext is not restored; affected connections require re-authentication through the encrypted OAuth callback once the provider is gated on (RELEASE-008)
recovery.forwardFix: Move any regressed consumer (venue route legacy refresh fallback, org analytics Edge Functions) to decrypting through the server vault boundary, then re-connect through the encrypted callback
